summary: Join our MEL for Emergency Response Programs Training to master essential evaluation strategies that improve emergency management and response effectiveness.
lede: MEL for emergency response programs helps teams collect and use evidence quickly, practically, and ethically while operations are underway. The course focuses on measuring meaningful change, demonstrating results, identifying risks, and understanding who benefited from the response. You will learn to build lean MEL systems, create response-ready indicators, plan rapid monitoring, use real-time feedback, maintain data quality, and communicate findings clearly. Practical outputs, templates, and field-ready tools help turn MEL from a compliance task into an operational resource for improving response quality.
audienceIntro: This course is tailored for professionals who are at the forefront of emergency responses, ensuring accountability and delivering results in crisis situations.
audience: Emergency response program managers and coordinators
MEL/MEAL officers and analysts in humanitarian settings
Government disaster management and humanitarian coordination staff
Sector leads (WASH, Health, Nutrition, Protection, Shelter
modules: Rapid Monitoring Plans and Field Workflows
Data Collection Tools for Emergency Programs
Accountability to Affected Populations (AAP) and Feedback
Risk, Safeguarding, and 'Do No Harm' Through MEL
Reporting for Donors, Clusters, and Leadership
prerequisites: Participants should have prior experience in emergency response or humanitarian operations, as well as basic knowledge of monitoring and evaluation principles.
